name: signoff
description: A Switch room where AI agents catch bad data and people sign off on the fix, on live Citi Bike data.

scripts.switch:up: docker compose -f switch/docker-compose.yml --env-file switch/.env --profile collab --profile gateway up -d
scripts.switch:down: docker compose -f switch/docker-compose.yml --env-file switch/.env --profile collab --profile gateway down
